examples.title: Tabbed states
examples.description: Switch between the four views with the pill tabs. Without onAction, no preset recovery button is rendered.

examples.title: Local recovery actions
examples.description: Clear filters, reconnect, refresh and go back change this local demo. Your app owns the actual data or request.

examples.title: Controlled view
examples.description: Use value and onValueChange for external selection. A selected view does not run a recovery action.

examples.title: Custom copy, icon and action
examples.description: Override only the states you need. Custom actions replace the preset button; null suppresses it.

examples.title: Both sizes
examples.description: Default preserves the full view. sm uses the compact EmptyState treatment inside the same shell.

examples.title: Right to left
examples.description: dir reaches the tab rail and panel. Keyboard navigation follows the underlying Tabs behavior.
